before: Formatting a paragraph of many runs emitted the same per-run operations and journal primitives, at quadratic or worse cost.
after: The same operations, primitives, and resulting trees are produced in time proportional to the paragraph length.
reason: Only memoization and the straddling-run search change. Operation shapes, primitive journals, node identities, and serialized output stay the same; formatting output is byte-identical to the previous release on the test fixtures.
